Doesn't seem to exist in ASVS [1.0](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/1.0/asvs-webapp-release-2009-en.pdf).
Exists in ASVS [2.0](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/2.0/OWASPApplicationSecurityVerificationStandard3.0.pdf) as 9.7.
Exists in ASVS [3.0.1](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/3.0.1/OWASP%20Application%20Security%20Verification%20Standard%203.0.1.pdf) as 9.7.
[Renumbered from 9.7 to 9.8](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/commit/c765bbf7f000b7715b5c5fd14254e991ad745979) in 2019.
[Renumbered from 9.8 to 9.1.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/commit/8924a4dd9a45606fc317bc3825753f09223c0632) in 2019.
[Renumbered from 9.1.3 to 8.1.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/commit/99f80b6ffe4276b5bedc7427d4f94b415554eb14) in 2019.
[Some previous discussion](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/934) in 2021.
